name: SendGrid
description: Transactional and marketing email delivery, verified senders, templates, statistics, and account administration through the Twilio SendGrid v3 API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned SendGrid API key once, select capabilities, and let agents inspect delivery state, send mail, or use the full supported v3 API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: SENDGRID_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: SendGrid API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create your own Custom Access key with only the permissions the agent needs.

credentialRequirements.name: SENDGRID_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: SendGrid region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter GLOBAL or EU for the account or regional subuser.

credentialRequirements.name: SENDGRID_SENDER_BOUNDARY
credentialRequirements.label: Sender boundary
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter an exact verified sender email or authenticated domain.

capabilities.label: Account profile
capabilities.description: Read bounded SendGrid account profile metadata.

capabilities.label: Send mail
capabilities.description: Send transactional or template email through the configured sender boundary.

capabilities.label: Full SendGrid v3 API
capabilities.description: Use the provider-supported SendGrid v3 API within the API key's permissions and configured region.

approvalRequired.label: Send mail
approvalRequired.description: Sending mail requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full SendGrid API
approvalRequired.description: Every other SendGrid v3 operation requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; sends and all other v3 operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The agent may use every selected SendGrid capability without Relay per-action approvals; provider scopes, connection ownership, sender binding, secret isolation, audit evidence, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected SendGrid tools and proxies the customer key server-side.
Railway mounts selected SendGrid tools and proxies the customer key server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer enters their own SendGrid key, region, and verified sender boundary in Relay Console.

evidence.supports: SendGrid v3 uses customer-created Bearer API keys rather than delegated customer OAuth.
SendGrid API keys can be assigned granular permissions that define the provider-enforced authority ceiling.
The Mail Send API supports global and EU origins, verified senders, transactional/templates payloads, at most 1,000 recipients, and a 30 MB request limit.
The official v3 reference covers sending, scheduled sends, senders/domains, templates, statistics, suppressions, marketing, contacts, subusers, API keys, security, and other account operations.
